name: tidex
description: Tidex monorepo - iOS app and supporting backend/web infrastructure

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter marketing exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter dev-site exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter marketing build && pnpm --filter dev-site build
scripts.tariff:hk-virke:backpay: pnpm dlx deno-bin@2.2.7 run --no-lock --allow-env --allow-net --config supabase/functions/deno.json scripts/hk-virke-backpay.ts
scripts.swiftlint: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; for arg in "$@"; do if [ "$arg" = "--fix" ] || [ "$arg" = "autocorrect" ]; then echo "swiftlint autocorrect is disabled in this repo. Use pnpm swift-format."; exit 1; fi; done; swiftlint lint "$@" && swift ios/Scripts/check-swift-imports.swift' --
scripts.swiftlint:analyze: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; if [ -n "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH" ]; then swiftlint analyze --strict --config .swiftlint.yml --compile-commands "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH" "$@"; elif [ -n "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH" ]; then swiftlint analyze --strict --config .swiftlint.yml --compiler-log-path "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH" "$@"; else echo "Set SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH or SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH"; exit 1; fi' --
